mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.candidate_event_id, d.candidate_id, d.detection_index, d.track_id, d.crop_object_key, d.similarity, CAST(d.bounding_box AS CHAR) AS bounding_box FROM candidate_event_detections d INNER JOIN candidate_events e ON e.id = d.candidate_event_id WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY d.detection_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidate_events (event_id, case_id, camera_id, source_type, analysis_job_id, recording_id, detected_at, frame_object_key) VALUES (#{event.eventId}, #{event.caseId}, #{event.cameraId}, COALESCE(#{event.sourceType}, 'REALTIME'), #{event.analysisJobId}, #{event.recordingId}, #{event.detectedAt}, #{event.frameObjectKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, case_id, camera_id, source_type, analysis_job_id, recording_id, dedupe_scope, track_id, first_detected_at, last_detected_at, best_similarity, average_similarity, detection_count, similarity, crop_object_key, frame_object_key, CAST(bounding_box AS CHAR) AS bounding_box, version, created_at FROM candidates WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND camera_id = #{cameraId} AND track_id = #{trackId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidates (case_id, camera_id, source_type, analysis_job_id, recording_id, track_id, detected_time, first_detected_at, last_detected_at, similarity, best_similarity, average_similarity, detection_count, crop_object_key, frame_object_key, bounding_box, review_status, version) VALUES (#{candidate.caseId}, #{candidate.cameraId}, COALESCE(#{candidate.sourceType}, 'REALTIME'), #{candidate.analysisJobId}, #{candidate.recordingId}, #{candidate.trackId}, #{candidate.firstDetectedAt}, #{candidate.firstDetectedAt}, #{candidate.lastDetectedAt}, #{candidate.similarity}, #{candidate.bestSimilarity}, #{candidate.averageSimilarity}, #{candidate.detectionCount}, #{candidate.cropObjectKey}, #{candidate.frameObjectKey}, #{candidate.boundingBox}, 'PENDING', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE candidates SET detected_time = CASE WHEN #{similarity} > similarity THEN #{detectedAt} ELSE detected_time END, first_detected_at = LEAST(first_detected_at, #{detectedAt}), last_detected_at = GREATEST(last_detected_at, #{detectedAt}), similarity = GREATEST(similarity, #{similarity}), best_similarity = GREATEST(best_similarity, #{similarity}), average_similarity = ((average_similarity * detection_count) + #{similarity}) / (detection_count + 1), detection_count = detection_count + 1, crop_object_key = CASE WHEN #{similarity} >= best_similarity THEN #{cropObjectKey} ELSE crop_object_key END, frame_object_key = CASE WHEN #{similarity} >= best_similarity THEN #{frameObjectKey} ELSE frame_object_key END, bounding_box = CASE WHEN #{similarity} >= best_similarity THEN #{boundingBox} ELSE bounding_box END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{candidate.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidate_event_detections (candidate_event_id, candidate_id, detection_index, track_id, crop_object_key, similarity, bounding_box) VALUES (#{detection.candidateEventId}, #{detection.candidateId}, #{detection.detectionIndex}, #{detection.trackId}, #{detection.cropObjectKey}, #{detection.similarity}, #{detection.boundingBox})
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_event_detections SET candidate_id = #{candidateId} WHERE id = #{id}
